description: HPMS Statewide Summaries 2019 is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by Federal Highway Administration, Office of Highway Policy Information. The Highway Performance Management System (HPMS) Statewide Summaries table contains demographic and system length estimates for all Urban and Rural public roads, functionally classified as minor collector in rural areas or local in any area, summarized by State. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 15 columns, among them State Code, RMC_VMT, SU_Land_Area, Rural_Pop, Paved_RMC_Length, Unpaved_UL_Length. The portal shows 2020-12-07 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Highway Administration, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
